glossary.definition: The immutable captured artifact and mechanical structural facts derived before interpretation (`EvidenceStore` `.evidence/<kind>/<sha256>.json`, `.librarian/quarantine/`, `.librarian/intake_queue.json`, `folder_intake` inventory facts, `.librarian/derived/dik/` component/chapter structures). May assert only that a component/byte sequence existed at a source/commit/date.
glossary.semantic_shift: V1 stored `.Data/surveys/*.json` & `source_components.sqlite`; V2 unified evidence into content-addressed `.evidence/` + structured `dik.py` JSON sidecars + explicit `quarantine/`. Must NOT be confused with Trust Tier `bronze`.

glossary.definition: Cleaned, conformed, **unframed (project-neutral)** descriptions emerging from relating Data points (`**Not read:**` where inferred in V1; in V2: hidden `.librarian/conversions/<evidence-id>.md` page-anchored text, `.librarian/staging/` airlock items, promoted `Sources/<kind>/<name>.md`, `Concepts/`, and rebuildable `.librarian/index.sqlite` / `Indexes/` / `.librarian/derived/paper-graph/`).
glossary.semantic_shift: V1 placed Resource notes here manually with `## Evidence` & `**Not read:**` guards; V2 added the hidden page-anchored `.librarian/conversions/` layer for third-party content governance and formal Staging CAS/lease airlock. Must NOT be confused with Trust Tier `silver`.

glossary.definition: Information interpreted and tested **against a specific project need, perspective, or real execution** (`Transferable Capability`, `Session`, `Brief`, `Candidate`, verified `Offerings/` gated by `EVIDENCE_QUOTE_VERIFIED`, and real-use `Applications/`). Knowledge cannot be asserted solely from a README; it requires either a new framing perspective over held Data/Information or real Application evidence.
glossary.semantic_shift: V1 separated `09-Applications/` and `branch offerings/`; V2 formalized prospective knowledge as `Offerings/` (created in `synthesise` with exact substring quote verification) and realised knowledge as `Applications/`. Must NOT be confused with Trust Tier `gold`.

glossary.definition: Grading material by level of refinement so that every derived stage is reproducible from the immutable stage before it, and errors are corrected by **replaying** rather than patching in place.
glossary.semantic_shift: Adopted from lakehouse terminology (`Victor-Kipruto-Rop`, `DOC-V1D-39`) and generalized in `Use Contexts And Agnostic Description` (`DOC-V1D-08`) to govern V1/V2 vault storage + rebuildable indexes (`MARKDOWN_IS_TRUTH` + `EvidenceStore`).

glossary.definition: Task/reasoning hierarchy: **Tier 0** (external overseer e.g. Claude/Codex outside vault via MCP `contribute`), **Tier 1** (`Lead`: session orchestrator & judgment inside a vault), **Tier 2** (`Clerk`: bounded drafting, descriptions, proofreading), **Tier 3** (`Scribe`: narrow chunk extraction, atomic formatting). **Oracle** (independent judge) and **Doctor** (scoped repairer) use isolated contexts and configured models (currently GLM-5.3).
glossary.semantic_shift: Early V2 (`PLAN - Librarian V2`, `M0 Results`) treated `[clerk]`/`[scribe]` inconsistently (Qwen-397B as Clerk costing 51% of M0 spend). `docs/policy/agent-roles-and-authority.md` (`DOC-POL-02`) standardized the 4-tier assignment and 'assign, never bind' rule.

glossary.definition: Write-authority boundary enforced by `Registry` and MCP server (`mcp_server.py`): **`consult`** (read + log use/applications), **`contribute`** (stage proposals, open/decide session candidates, write drafts inside permitted session phases; max tier for agents), **`curate`** (accept staged items into library `Sources/`/`Concepts/`/`topics`, accept vault pipelines, approve `process_approved` batches — **Owner/person-only** when `promotion.mode='person'`).
glossary.semantic_shift: Originated in V1 `mcp_server.py` alongside `consult/borrow`; V2 added session-phase write gates on top (`session.WRITES`) and `Broker` permission modes (`Ask`/`Auto`/`Plan`). Note `process_approved` batch start requires `curate` (`TIER_REFUSED` via MCP `contribute`).

glossary.definition: Quality/trust classification on graphs, nodes, or checked cross-graph W5 relations: e.g., `bronze` for third-party code graphs or weak structural match; higher tiers earned through verification/evidence checks. Separate from Medallion storage layers even though the names collide.
glossary.semantic_shift: Introduced in Wave L (`DOC-POL-09`) and `agent-roles-and-authority.md` (`DOC-POL-02`) alongside W5 relation scoring (`DOC-PLN-02`), creating an explicit homonym risk with Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion layers.

glossary.definition: Model selection rule: models are configured dynamically against roles (`routes.json`) through a qualification record; workflows never hard-bind a specific vendor/model checkpoint inside architectural definitions.
glossary.semantic_shift: Adopted across Oct-Nov 2026 specs (`DOC-POL-02`, `DOC-POL-12`, `DOC-PLN-06`) after Sept/Oct hardcoded tier defaults caused brittle routing.

glossary.definition: The single long-lived process per mutable library holding the vault lease, serializing all SQLite reads/writes on a dedicated `IndexService` worker thread, and serializing all vault Markdown/JSONL writes through `VaultWriter` with atomic temp+replace and revision CAS tokens.
glossary.semantic_shift: Built in CORE-01..07 and INDEX-01..05 to eliminate V1 multi-process SQLite `SQLITE_BUSY` races and uncoordinated direct file writes.

glossary.term: Ingest (`intake.ingest`) vs Enrichment Batch (`process_approved`) vs Acceptance (`staging_decide` / `promote`)
glossary.definition: **CRITICAL DISTINCTION:** In V2, `ingest(ref)` **does NOT accept into the library**; it captures bytes/structure into `.evidence/`, runs mechanical fact derivation, calls `clerk` for a short unframed description, and **stages** an item (`staged_sources`). **`process_approved`** (person/curate-started, after approving items for batch) runs the 9 source stages (`validate -> parse -> read -> lenses -> data -> relate -> metadata -> review -> publish`) or 3 folder stages (`folder_validate -> folder_describe -> folder_data`), reducing status to `enriched`/`partial`/`failed`. **`staging_decide(..., 'accept')` -> `promote`** executes guarded library publication into `Sources/` + index + findability check.
glossary.semantic_shift: Cause of recurring model & user confusion since V2 launched (`DOC-V1D-30`, `DOC-V1D-34`, `DOC-MAP-02`). V2 consolidated V1's fragmented `populate`/`papers`/`enrich`/`lens` into these two explicit airlock gates.

glossary.definition: The quarantine/review buffer separating unverified extracted drafts, folder classification cards, concept/topic proposals, source revisions, and draft offerings from canonical reader-facing Markdown.
glossary.semantic_shift: Renamed from V1 'proposal airlock' (`propose_resource`) into V2 multi-kind `StagingStore` (`source`, `lens`, `concept`, `folder`, `topic`, `revision`, `offering`).

glossary.definition: `owner_created` = owner's own code/notes (ingested in full); `generated` = Librarian/agent outputs (never cited as original source); `third_party` (also called `unlicensed` in Owner notes) = external works studied & cited (restricted to S1-S6b/R scope, stored under `.librarian/conversions/` for agents, external graph domain only).
glossary.semantic_shift: Formalized Nov 14, 2026 (`DOC-POL-06`, `DOC-POL-08`, `DOC-GEO-01`); explains why nested repos or vendor trees trigger `third_party`/`unlicensed` handling.

glossary.definition: **Provenance** is the recorded history of *how* an artifact came to exist (which code, commit, inputs, route/model, version, environment). **Lineage** describes structural derivation relationships *between* datasets/artifacts (`original -> conversion -> reading -> claim -> source note -> offering`).
glossary.semantic_shift: Clarified explicitly in V1 Glossary (`DOC-V1D-44`) and carried into `provenance.py`, `EvidenceStore`, and `operators-and-views.md` §3.

glossary.definition: A reusable analytical perspective extracted from deep reading (`PERSPECTIVE -> ATTENTION -> ROLE -> SYNTHESIZE`) with grounded verbatim quote checks, staged in Staging and promoted to `.librarian/lenses.sqlite`, adoptable into sessions or applied to diagrams.
glossary.semantic_shift: Originated in Aletheia (`configs/reasoning_lenses_v0_1.yaml`, May 2025, `DOC-V1D-18`), matured into V1 `lens.py` chunk scanner, then V2 `deep_read` lens chain + `.librarian/lenses.sqlite` + diagram validation lenses (`the-root-cause-lens`, etc.).

glossary.term: DIK Builder (`dik.py`) vs Paper Graph (`paper_graph.py`) vs Geo-Grapher
glossary.definition: **`dik.py`** derives mechanical local repository/document structural Data (`.librarian/derived/dik/` chapters/components/sections); **`paper_graph.py`** serializes pre-read provisional or post-read populated `.nodes.json` paper claims/terms and shells out to Geo-Grapher CLI (`import-library-paper`); **Geo-Grapher** (`geographer`) builds persistent SQLite AST/call/doc/paper graphs + MCP query service. **`graphify` is retired**.
glossary.semantic_shift: V1 used external `graphify-out/graph.json`; Nov 2026 policy retired `graphify` (`DOC-POL-06:159`) in favour of native Geo-Grapher + Librarian `dik.py` + `paper_graph.py`.

glossary.definition: Strict upward composition hierarchy (`DOC-POL-03`): deterministic single **Action** (tool) -> **Workflow** (sequences Actions + asks/checks) -> **Pipeline** (sequences Workflows) -> **Sprint** (tracks milestones across Pipelines). No downward inversion or nested pipelines inside workflows.
glossary.semantic_shift: Formalized in `composition.md` (`DOC-POL-03`) to prevent ad-hoc Python orchestrators and unsafe auto-grants (`F-03`).

glossary.definition: Eight runtime ingestion/enrichment/Geo boundary issues tracked in Nov 15-22 audits: **OP1** split-brain (`awaiting_acceptance()` added Nov 21), **OP2** non-incremental all-group Geo rebuild on unrelated stale root, **OP3-OP7** silent TS failures/O(N^2) paper-DB cloning/0 bridges/queue drops/mixed folder failures, **OP8** malformed `terms` JSON retry (`route_review` added Nov 21).
glossary.semantic_shift: Several code-level pieces (OP1 status helper, OP8 review retry) landed in `d9435e1`, while OP2 group amplification and Geo O(N^2) paper DB cloning remained live on Nov 22.

glossary.definition: **Quarantine** holds unfetchable/malformed/oversized or rejected artifacts explicitly with reasons instead of silent dropping. **Withdrawal** (proposed in `MC-14`) suppresses current retrieval/merge across derived views/vectors while preserving audit lineage. **Deletion** removes bytes physically, leaving an unavailable audit marker.
glossary.semantic_shift: V1 lacked unified quarantine (silent drops noted in early audits); V2 added `.librarian/quarantine/` and fresh-rejection quarantine safety (`DOC-PLN-04`), while withdrawal propagation (`MC-14` / `MF-012/036`) remains proposed.

glossary.term: EVIDENCE_QUOTE_VERIFIED / PHASE_GATE / PERSON_CONFIRMS / TIER_REFUSED / CORE_REQUIRED / FOLDER_STALE
glossary.definition: Machine-enforced Core refusals: **`EVIDENCE_QUOTE_VERIFIED`** requires `draft_offering` citations to match exact contiguous substrings of stored source text; **`PHASE_GATE`** blocks writes outside allowed session phases; **`PERSON_CONFIRMS`** requires UI/person confirmation when `promotion.mode='person'`; **`TIER_REFUSED`** blocks `contribute`/MCP agents from `curate` actions; **`CORE_REQUIRED`** refuses offline SQLite fallback when a Core is active/expected; **`FOLDER_STALE`** blocks paper Geo publication when parent folder survey fingerprint changed.
glossary.semantic_shift: Carried from V1 named refusals (`EVIDENCE_REQUIRED`, etc.) into machine-checked Core invariants across `registry.py`, `session.py`, `promote.py`, `offerings.py`, `paper_graph.py`.

glossary.definition: PROPOSED (`composition.md` Rules 15-17, NOT ACCEPTED / NOT IMPLEMENTED): A single upfront, Core-stored authorization envelope (`mandate_id`) declaring permitted tools, write effects, target roots, budget ceiling, permitted partials, and expiration. In Context 1 (user directing Tier 0 to work with Librarian), the human's explicit instruction and stated scope ARE the commission, and Tier 0 approves the Rule 15 envelope on the user's behalf with zero second human approval step (`spec_owner: tier0_on_behalf_of_person`, `commissioned_by: person, decided_by: agent`), holding the permissions needed inside that commissioned scope while reserving out-of-scope/budget raises, uncommissioned standing global governance changes, `ORACLE_ROUTE_COLLISION`, plus any Owner-retained `OD-05` sensitivity/challenged-claim exception. Distinct from Context 2 (`external_project_caller` bounded to research helpers, S1-S6b source access, async queue or opt-in `stage_only` intake, no vault acceptance, and `Applications/` authoring), Context 3 (direct human UI `spec_owner: person` without Tier 0), and present-day `d9435e1` (`librarian-current-activation`, `IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED`).
glossary.semantic_shift: Replaces fragile session-by-session Ask prompts (`F-03` 150s/600s timeouts) and extends the concept of `App.start_action`'s `workflow_grant` to Context-1 commissioned runs without impersonating `person` identity.

glossary.definition: Separates present-day `d9435e1` activation (`librarian-current-activation`, `IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED`) from three distinct `PROPOSED_UNACCEPTED` upstream L3 models: **Context 1** (Human directs Tier 0 agent to operate Librarian; instruction + scope IS the commission, `spec_owner=tier0_on_behalf_of_person`, `OD-05` flags Rule-16 sensitivity/challenged-claim Owner ruling), **Context 2** (External-project Tier 0 via MCP under explicit 5-domain bounds, `spec_owner=external_project_caller`, no vault acceptance, and agent-authored `extapply` -> Core-stored `recordapp` `Applications/` logging), and **Context 3** (Human operates Librarian Web UI directly with zero Tier 0 actor, `spec_owner=person`).
glossary.semantic_shift: Supersedes Phase 1's single-node 3-way `dtrigger` shorthand by separating present-day verified behaviour, `spec_owner`, delegated authority boundaries, handoff, and user notification across contexts.

glossary.definition: PROPOSED (`NOT ACCEPTED / NOT IMPLEMENTED`): A structured, Core-persisted fault/hold record used by `Doctor`, `Oracle`, `Lead`, and Staging/Agenda workflows. Preserves applicable failure or extension identifiers (e.g., `R1`–`R6`, `3b`, `4a`, `6c`/`6d`, `7c`, `8a`, `10b`/`10c`, `14c`/`14d`, `17c`/`17d`, `20d`), tiered flags/refusal codes (`FOLDER_STALE`, `EMPTY_PAPER_GRAPH`, `THIRD_PARTY_ROUTE_REQUIRED`, `not_findable`, `ORACLE_ROUTE_COLLISION` with `review_status='unverified_route_collision'`), raw evidence hashes, accountable actor, `repair_history`, immediate critical routing vs bounded Doctor recovery, independent `Oracle` recheck verdict, and explicit human/agent notification target.
glossary.semantic_shift: Replaces unrouted error logs and auto-rollback failures (`UC-D` `x4`) with traceable policy-routed accountability (`DOC-MAP-28`) and fail-closed route-collision holds.

glossary.definition: Gold-layer Vault record (`Applications/Application - <title>.md`) created at checkout of an `apply` session (`tools/sessions.py:1948-2049`): External Tier 0 authors external need, what was found/taken, replaced, project files/changes, and verification (`extapply`), while Core validates `sources_used` citations (`[[note]]`), stores the append-only Markdown + project-sidecar JSON pointer, and auto-queues fetchable `unresolved_sources` leads (`recordapp`).
glossary.semantic_shift: Core persistence implemented in `d9435e1`; PROPOSED (NOT ACCEPTED) Context 2 extensions add source snapshot/locator pinning (`cite_as`/`evidence_sha256`), external environment constraints, repeatability verification status, and non-blocking empty-`sources_used` (`no_match_workaround`) logging.
